subject: Pilot credit structure for Arden Tech RFP - counterproposal
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@ardentech.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@ardentech.com>, Ella Moreno <ella.moreno@ardentech.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: extended evaluation credits for Arden Tech RFP

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and multi-tenant routing notes were especially helpful. We're finalizing the RFP package and the evaluation committee asked whether Redwood would consider a dedicated evaluation stipend to run a focused benchmark across our top three use cases (search-relevance, chat summarization, and realtime reranking).

High level ask: 250k generated tokens (approx. 30–40 full runs across data slices) + access to models with quantized variants over two weeks. We also need an export of token-level logs for our QA team and a short SLO statement for the pilot.

Can you share what flexibility you have on credits/stipends for RFPs and any standard terms? We have a deadline for the procurement appendix by 12/15.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Engineering | Arden Tech

Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extended evaluation credits for Arden Tech RFP — proposed package

Olga — rough proposal below based on past bakeoffs and ARDEN's scale:

Proposal (pilot stipend):
- 200,000 generated-token credit applied to a dedicated eval project (valid for 21 days).
- Access to two quantized model variants (q4 and q3/8) plus a single request to test full-precision if needed.
- Token-level logs export (S3 link) for QA; logs retained for 30 days.
- Reporting: one joint benchmark run with our solutions engineer; results slide deck + short technical note.
- Conditions: one-time stipend for RFP evaluation only, not for production. Usage beyond stipend billed per standard rates.

Rationale: 200k balances cost risk and gives them enough runs across three use cases. We can add an extra 50k but that requires manager approval and a clear reciprocity (e.g., signed SOW or explicit commitment to a pilot).

Attachments: proposed_stipend_summary.pdf (includes cost estimate and similar precedents)

If you want I can draft the exact language for procurement appendix and a simple SOW addendum.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
AE, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extended evaluation credits for Arden Tech RFP — approval

Marissa / Olga — Approved with guardrails.

Decision: approve 250k total tokens, but with the following binding conditions:
1) Stipend is conditional on Arden signing a two-week pilot SOW with defined success criteria and a commitment to a commercial evaluation statement (non-binding) that lists Redwood as a vendor in the procurement appendix.
2) Any usage beyond 250k will be billed at our commercial trial rate; engineering will throttle if suspicious patterns appear.
3) Logs export OK but masked for PII by default; if they require raw logs we need a data sharing MOU and legal sign-off.
4) Finance must approve promotional write-off up to $X (internal) — Monica will confirm.

Marissa: please incorporate manager-approval clause in the stipend PDF and prepare the SOW addendum. Olga: please send the external offer with these conditions and the DocuSign link; include a 12/15 deadline note.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clarity and timeline. We can support a dedicated RFP evaluation package with the following offer:

Offer summary:

- Access to two quantized model variants + one full-precision trial request.
